text_block_list.text:
Today is the Mile Championship, and
powerful
runners Бико Пегасус and Hishi
Akebono will be
running.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Фудзи Кисэки is feeling nervous, but the
three of
them wish each other a good
race and do a
pre-race ritual together to
get ready.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
With her spirits lifted, Фудзи Кисэки is
ready for
anything. The race begins.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
